rounds.title_zh: 非均匀挤压拉伸法向不歪斜高光不死黑：余子式伴随逆转置法向矩阵与模型矩阵直乘选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Squash-and-stretch lighting without tilted normals or specular blackout: cofactor inverse-transpose normal matrix vs forward model-matrix transform FAQ
conclusions_zh: 在非均匀挤压拉伸（s_x=2.50, s_y=0.40, k_xy=0.20）下，直接用模型矩阵 M·n 变换表面法向会将 +45° 肩部法向随顶点压扁至 8.43°（偏离真实法向 71.71°），导致顶光漫反射照度暴跌 68.61%。
采用无除法的 3×3 余子式伴随矩阵 cof(M)=[c₁×c₂, c₂×c₀, c₀×c₁] 可严格保持全部 17 个站点的切法内积 n'·t'≡0.000000（90.00° 正交）与 100.00% 顶光照度。
58 实体 17 站点挤压拉伸量角器台对比三列叉积余子式与通用高斯-若尔当 3×3 求逆转置（8192 次 116.15 ms vs 143.53 ms，0 误差），不冒充神经 4DGS 重打光。
conclusions_en: Under non-uniform squash-and-stretch (s_x=2.50, s_y=0.40, k_xy=0.20), transforming normals by M·n squashes the +45° shoulder normal down to 8.43° (71.71° tilt error), losing 68.61% of overhead key-light irradiance.
Using the division-free 3×3 cofactor adjugate matrix cof(M)=[c₁×c₂, c₂×c₀, c₀×c₁] locks tangent-normal orthogonality n'·t'≡0.000000 (90.00°) across all 17 stations and retains 100.00% key light.

The 58-solid 17-station protractor rig compares column cross-product cofactors against 3×3 Gauss-Jordan inversion + transpose (116.15 ms vs 143.53 ms at 8,192 passes, 0 error) without claiming neural 4DGS relighting.
